integrity: A complete linear-algebra argument and reproducible finite checks accompany this finding; finite checks are corroborative, not a universal certificate. No independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only simple Grassmann adjacency graphs in first-order adjacency/equality at quantifier rank at most three. The 1395-vertex bound is sharp only within the Grassmann family. Source scans cannot rule out unindexed, inaccessible, or equivalent earlier results. Universal correctness relies on the written proof rather than finite verification logs. Independent audit has not been performed.
title: Three rank-three theories of finite Grassmann adjacency graphs
